case_title: FORD GREGORY THOMAS VS FRELOW RENE DBA INTL ACADEMY PERCISION HAIRCUTTING

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $300.00 FILED BY FORD GREGORY THOMAS AS TO DEFENDANT FRELOW RENE DBA INTL ACADEMY PERCISION HAIRCUTTING ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-15-1991 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 04
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT FRELOW RENE DBA INTL ACADEMY PERCISION HAIRCUTTING

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF FORD GREGORY THOMAS IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT FRELOW RENE DBA INTL ACADEMY PERCISION HAIRCUTTING STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
